description: Rename a child workspace, change its externalId, its monthly limit on transfers in (monthlyLimitCents) or its automatic refill (autoRefill: thresholdCents and amountCents); null clears.

anyOf.description: Automatic refill from the parent: at most once a UTC day, when the child runs low.

amountCents.description: How much each refill moves from the parent, in USD cents (100 to 500000).

thresholdCents.description: Refill when the child's effective balance (balance minus usage not settled yet) drops under this, in USD cents.

autoRefill.description: The automatic refill; null turns it off.

externalId.description: Your own id for it; null clears it.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. A unique value (a UUID) for this call: 1 to 255 visible ASCII characters, no spaces. Calling again with the same key and the same input within 24 hours returns the first result instead of doing it twice.

monthlyLimitCents.description: The monthly ceiling on transfers in, in USD cents; null removes it.

name: update_workspace
title: Update workspace
